% of its earlier biblatex build are beside it. The PDF build reads the
% stale .bbl in its first run, then bibtex writes a new one. The page
% shows the citation and the entry of bibtex, from the .bib, and its log
% shows no error.
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
Cited~\cite{fresh}.
\bibliographystyle{plain}
\bibliography{test-staleaux-bbl}
\end{document}
